Article 2.1: Standard OG Accounts (Full Specifications)

Warren's summary

Standard OG accounts are no longer sold, but existing OG accounts keep their original rules and cannot be reset once blown. To pass evaluation, traders must complete a minimum of 7 trading days with at least 1 trade per day, hit the profit target, and ensure no single trading session accounts for more than 40% of total profit (exceeding 40% increases the target rather than failing immediately). News trading is permitted during evaluation and does not blow the account. After passing evaluation, traders pay a $120 activation fee to move to Exhibition, where they build a buffer before accessing the funded account with same-day payout eligibility.

OG accounts are no longer sold. Existing OG accounts keep their rules. Once a Standard OG account is blown, it cannot be reset. Traders looking for a new account should consider Standard MAX or STEADY.

What Is a Standard OG Account?

A Standard OG account is the original FFN evaluation path. Traders must complete a minimum of 7 trading days, hit the profit target, and stay within the 40% consistency rule. After passing, they enter an Exhibition account to build their buffer before receiving a funded account.

Evaluation Rules: Standard OG
Drawdown Type: Realized Trailing (trailing updates after each trade closes, not intraday)
Daily Loss Limit: None
Minimum Trading Days: 7 days (at least 1 trade per day to count)
Consistency Rule: No single trading session may account for more than 40% of the total profit target. Exceeding 40% increases the profit target to maintain consistency: it does not immediately fail the account.
News Trading: Permitted in evaluation. Does NOT blow the account. (Restricted in Exhibition and Funded; see Article 3.3)
Activation Fee (to Exhibition): $120 (may be waived during promotions)
Evaluation Reset Fee: $100 (Discord discounts available)

Funded Account Rules: Standard OG (Sim-Funded)
Drawdown Type: Static +$100 (once buffer is reached, stops trailing; see Article 4.2)
Consistency Rule: 40%, based on your best day net P&L vs. total profit withdrawn
Payout Frequency: Same-day (any day you are eligible, you can request)
Copy-trading: Permitted (within the copy-trading rules; see Category 7)
